assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional interpretations of the organizer's public description and may not be used as official redlines, statutory boundaries, or precise area bases.
assumptions.impact: All area and ratio values derived from these polygons are recomputable discussion metrics. When official polygons are released, replace site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson and regenerate every dependent layer, metric, figure, PDF, and HTML output.

assumptions.statement: The organizer has not yet published official site-boundary or key-area polygons in the public submission package.
assumptions.impact: The package discloses the precision limit and preserves a traceable provisional geometry for design discussion; no official boundary or exact area claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a formal AI design submission for review, while statutory controls, official boundaries, and engineering conclusions still require professional confirmation.
